Gold.note: Central bank accumulation and macro hedging support elevated price levels.

Silver.note: Photovoltaic demand and precious metal tailwinds drive structural outperformance.

Copper.note: Concentrate shortages and grid electrification demand underpin a bullish structure.

Uranium.note: Structural primary supply deficit and global nuclear restarts support firm pricing.

Lithium.note: Near-term supply surplus and normalized EV battery demand growth weigh on margins.

Nickel.note: Indonesian supply growth outpaces stainless and battery demand keeping market well supplied.

Zinc.note: Mine closures and low smelter treatment charges tighten refined supply.

Iron Ore.note: Softening Chinese property sector demand outweighs steady infrastructure spending.

Coal.note: Resilient Asian thermal demand is balanced by ample seaborne supply.

Rare Earths.note: Strategic supply controls and EV motor demand offset near-term inventory destocking.

Manganese.note: Steady global crude steel production offsets minor localized supply disruptions.

PGM.note: Near-term auto production softness offsets long-term hydrogen economy potential.

Potash.note: Tight global supply from Eastern Europe supports pricing amid steady agricultural demand.

Aluminum.note: Chinese smelter capacity caps and renewable energy demand tighten the primary market.

Diversified.note: Broad exposure balances copper and gold strength against iron ore and nickel weakness.
